name: Ralph O'Dell
notable_stories: Uncle Ralph came with George Sr. to one of John's high school games, the only one John remembers his father attending.
sources: John Howard Adams, "John Howard Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)
notes: CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Previously recorded as "Ralph Simons", a brother of Beryl Simons Adams (from the Adams direct-line summary). Brendan Adams confirms Ralph was not a Simons: he was the husband of Rosemary Wells, on the Adams side. Surname not recorded.
Surname O'Dell per Brendan Adams, 2026-09-22. Husband of Rosemary Wells.
